review.notes: Entrance transition, countdown 2 and initial fighting on both phones. Final Corviknight Payback, blackout/logo and brief GAME WIN graphic included; result refined between native keyframes.
Entrance precedes Melmetal/Corviknight lead combat, with distinct score 1-0. Final Corviknight/Florges resolution, blackout and MATCH WIN graphic covered. Result refined between keyframes.
Countdown 2 and GO visible on both views of a new pairing. Last Ursaluna Swift and both trainer/result screens covered.

Countdown 2 and GO followed by Melmetal mirror fight at new score 1-0. Early right-camera header fragments belong to the same uninterrupted game. Final Ursaluna Swift, faint/result and MATCH WIN graphic included.

Countdown 2 and 1 precede Sableye/Thievul lead and immediate Vigoroth switch. Early right-camera charge/header fragments joined under uninterrupted left coverage. Final Acrobatics and YOU WIN/GOOD EFFORT on both phones included.
Countdown 2 and GO visible on both phones. Final Drain Punch, resolution and GAME WIN graphic covered. Distinct live game at score 0-0.

Entrance transition and countdown precede first combat. Last Chilling Water, faint and trainers/result covered on both phones. Right cut extended to the peer's result time; original result evidence retained.
Game introduction precedes first combat. Full distinct game at score 1-1; final Quagsire/Ninetales fight, trainers and MATCH WIN graphic included.
Entrance transition, GO and initial fighting visible. Final fight resolves to both trainers before the desk/winner scene. Different pairing, score 0-0; right ending shares left result evidence.

Starts on the exit transition from the preceding labelled replay, then countdown 2 on both phones and new live score 1-0. Whole game and GOOD EFFORT/result covered. The lead-in transition does not count as another battle.

selection_rule: First five complete, paired, result-visible games in chronological order per official source, after boundary review. Both perspectives share one battle ID. No selection by tracking verdict.
